Admitted to the NICU for observation of a late preterm baby. Total serum bilirubin was 14.9 mg/dL on day 3. Single surface
phototherapy was started and given for 2 days (about 40 hours); bilirubin fell to 9.8 mg/dL and phototherapy was stopped.

passed. NICU stay of 4 days. No CPAP or ventilator support was needed.
Treatment given
  Phototherapy 2 days
  Breast feeds every 2-3 hours, supplemental expressed milk
  Vitamin K given at birth
  Monitoring of bilirubin, blood sugar and weight
Condition at discharge
Stable, feeding well, SpO2 98% in room air, weight 2.4 kg. Discharged on direct breast feeding.

  Exclusive breast feeding on demand. Keep the baby warm; sunlight exposure is not a substitute for medical review.
